[P2] Add caller/callee integration coverage for propagation

This fake checkpoint completes invokes by echoing their payloads without running a callee. The sampling-authority suite also fakes this boundary, while the serializer regression checks only outgoing JSON. These tests cannot detect dropped `XAmznTraceId`, lost `Sampled=0`, or incorrect caller-operation ancestry. CONTRIBUTING.md requires integration coverage for public API changes. Add a deployed caller/callee example and integration test that captures the received carrier and verifies trace identity, calling-operation ancestry, and sampled/unsampled behavior for both OTel views.
